title: Macular degeneration and diabetic retinopathy
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's eye condition.
note:
Chief Complaint: Vision loss in right eye.

HPI: Pt is a 90 y.o. male presenting for scheduled ophthalmology follow-up. Pt reports progressive blurring and distortion of vision in the right eye over several months. Pt states vision is significantly impacted during daily activities. Pt has a known history of macular degeneration. Today's visit is for management of active choroidal neovascularization. Pt denies sudden flashes, floaters, or new-onset pain.

Medication List:
- Lisinopril 10mg QD
- Atorvastatin 20mg QD
- Aspirin 81mg QD

Review of Systems:
Constitutional: Negative for fever, chills, fatigue.
HEENT: Positive for blurred vision in right eye. Negative for ear pain or sinus congestion.
CV: Negative for chest pain, palpitations, or SOB.
MSK: Negative for joint pain or swelling.
Neuro: Negative for numbness, tingling, or weakness.

Social History: Pt is retired. Lives with wife in a single-story home. No tobacco or alcohol use.

Family History: Father had hypertension and stroke. Mother had heart disease.

Family History: Pt's father had hypertension and stroke. Mother had heart disease.

Vitals:
BP: 138/84
HR: 72 (RRR)
Temp: 98.6 F
SpO2: 97% on RA
Ht/WBC: WNL

Recent Labs:
eGFR: 68 mL/min
HbA1c: 6.2%

Exam:
Visual Acuity (OD): 20/100
Pupils: PERRLA
Extraocular Movements: Intact
Fundus Exam: Examination of right eye reveals exudative age-related macular degeneration. Notable active CNV present.

Assessment:
1. Exudative macular degeneration of the right eye.
2. Active choroidal neovascularization of the right eye.

Plan:
1. Administered anti-VEGF injection to the right eye today to treat active CNV.
2. Pt instructed on post-procedure care and signs of infection.
3. F/u in 4-8 weeks for repeat imaging and visual acuity check.

Electronically signed,
L. Moreau, DO
05/14/2026
explanations: Exudative (wet) AMD, right eye, with active choroidal neovascularization: H35.3211 (HCC 300).

distractors.why: Wet (exudative) AMD is documented; dry AMD has no HCC.
The neovascularization is documented as active.
